welcome.title: Welcome to Version 3
welcome.text: PrismaTeams 3.0.0 is here – a refreshed design, new modules, and many day-to-day improvements for your team.

highlights.design: A fresher UI, clearer navigation, and a consistent design language.
highlights.modules: New and expanded modules: Assessment, Music, Shortlinks, Booking, Events, and more.
highlights.security: Stronger security with 2FA, bot protection, guest accounts, and session management.

items.design: New design language across the portal – clearer, calmer, and more consistent.
items.accent: Accent colors are applied more reliably in more places.
items.alerts: Alert bubbles adjusted to cause less layout shift.
items.navigation: Desktop sidebar and mobile navigation redesigned.
items.context_menus: Context menus in many modules for faster actions.
items.setup: Setup wizard and first-time configuration improved.
items.push: Web push subscriptions and notifications expanded (including admin management).
items.email_templates: Unified email template system for all system mails.
items.pdf: PDF generator reworked (inventory, events, booking, QR).
items.i18n: Translations and multilingual support expanded further.

items.widgets: Widgets and quick access extended with new modules.
items.quick_access: Dashboard editing supports Events, Assessment, Music, Media Download, and more.
items.design: Design and layout tweaks for the home page.

items.rate_limit: Rate limiting against brute-force login attempts.
items.bot: Bot protection with Google reCAPTCHA or Cloudflare Turnstile (login/registration).
items.guests: Guest accounts with module-based access control.

items.design: Design update for desktop and mobile.
items.socket: Socket.IO / Redis stability for realtime messages.

items.design: Design refresh for a clearer file overview.
items.private: Private folders, spaces, trash, and ACL.
items.upload: Upload progress and conflict handling (new version).
items.favorites: Save up to 10 folders as favorites.
items.locks: Exclusive soft locks for the text/markdown editor.
items.admin_settings: New admin settings for the files module.
items.upload_limit: Larger uploads possible – depending on admin settings.
items.user_quota: Per-user storage quota can be set.

items.day_view: Day view for a quick overview.
items.multi_mode: Multi-calendar mode for people and teams.
items.context: Context menu: create events directly from the view.

items.new_module: Dedicated events module with appointments, assignments, and needs.
items.inventory_link: Checkouts can be linked to an event and appointment.

items.design: Design adjustments for a clearer interface.
items.permissions: Read and send permissions per user.
items.sent_folder: Sent mail can be stored in the IMAP Sent folder.
items.templates: System mails use the new unified template.

items.design: Design update for the contacts overview.

items.checkout: New checkout system (borrow/return) including contact details.
items.product_fields: More product fields: weight, dimensions, prices, DGUV, barcode, damage photo.
items.event_link: Checkouts can be linked to events and appointments.
items.colors: Color codes more readable for small differences.
items.fixes: API compatibility and further bug fixes.

items.module: Booking module with public forms and approval.
items.forms: Customizable forms, uploads, and applicant fields.
items.messages: Message thread between staff and applicant.
items.pdf_mail: PDF export and new mail templates including staff messages.

items.module: Music module for wishes and team playlists.
items.design: Design update for the music UI.

items.module: New assessment module for juries and competitions.
items.design: Dedicated design and isolated jury view.
items.jury: Jury accounts without a full portal account.

items.module: New shortlinks module for short, shareable links.
items.sharing: Integration with file shares and sharing flows.

items.design: Design and UI update for the download interface.
